data.gender_notes: Chhagan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Chhagan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Chhaya', which means shadow or shelter. The name Chhagan is associated with the Hindu god of fortune and prosperity, Lord Kubera. It is believed that a child named Chhagan will be blessed with wealth, happiness, and success in life. The name Chhagan carries the meaning “God of Fortune” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chhagan usually hope their child will grow to embody god of fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Chhagan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Fortune.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chhagan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: In Hindu mythology, Chhagan is significant as the name of Lord Kubera, who is the king of Alakapuri, the abode of Lord Kubera, and the god of wealth and prosperity in Hinduism. It is believed that the name Chhagan carries the blessings of Lord Kubera, bringing wealth, prosperity, and success in all endeavors. The name is also associated with the idea of providing shelter or protection to those around, making it an honorable and respected name in Hindu culture.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Chhagan lies in its connection to Lord Kubera, the Hindu god of wealth and prosperity. It is believed that the name Chhagan has been bestowed with divine blessings and is auspicious for those who carry it. It represents the idea of being a source of shelter, protection, and prosperity to those around. The name resonates with the spiritual values of Hinduism, such as prosperity, happiness, and good fortune, and is considered to be a source of inspiration and motivation for individuals to strive for success and prosperity in life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Chhagan signifies the radiant and auspicious one, symbolizing the inner light that illuminates one's path. It is a name of reverence and respect, evoking images of joy, prosperity, and divine grace.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Chhagan was a Jain Tirthankara of the 12th cycle of Jainism. The name Chhagan carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
